# Hue / Saturation

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Adjust hue and saturation of a layer.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "hue-saturation", "name": "hue-saturation", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "extension"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:hue`, or read elsewhere as `ch('hue-saturation/hue')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
